definitions.explanation: A gradual loss of strength, vitality, or quality. Used for physical, mental, or abstract things that weaken over time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衰|おとろ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel a decline in my physical strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{記憶力|きおくりょく}→記憶力：17616_kiokuryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衰|おとろ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: Memory decline has started to appear with age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{衰|おとろ}え⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧まったく⟦{見|み}られない→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: There is absolutely no sign of decline in his popularity.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {衰|おとろ}える (to weaken, to decline). Describes a gradual, ongoing process of losing strength or quality rather than a sudden drop.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衰|おとろ}え: decline in physical strength
- ⟦{記憶力|きおくりょく}→記憶力：17616_kiokuryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衰|おとろ}え: decline in memory
- ⟦{気力|きりょく}→気力：08515_kiryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衰|おとろ}え: loss of motivation
- {衰|おとろ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel the effects of aging/decline
- {衰|おとろ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧: to show signs of decline
- {衰|おとろ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to show no signs of decline (set phrase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧: decrease — more objective and measurable; used for numbers, statistics, and performance
- ⟦{劣化|れっか}→劣化：07647_rekka⟧: degradation — used for materials, equipment, and quality deteriorating
- ⟦{衰退|すいたい}→衰退：07428_suitai⟧: decline — used for larger-scale phenomena like civilizations, industries, or organizations
